metadata.question: Was there an active fire present in Monte Pisano in Northern Italy between February 24, 2019 and February 26, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search Strategy: Use MODIS active fire data (MODIS/006/MOD14A1 or MODIS/006/MYD14A1) which provides thermal anomalies/fire detection. Monte Pisano in Northern Italy is around (43.8°N, 10.5°E). 2. Masking Strategy: No cloud masking needed for fire detection products - they're designed to detect thermal anomalies through clouds. 3. Logic: Check if any fire pixels (FireMask band) with confidence level > 0 exist in the region during the specified dates. Let me implement this step by step: - Define geometry for Monte Pisano region - Get MODIS fire data for the date range - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Count valid fire pixels (C2) - Check if any active fires detected (A/B) - Handle calculation failures (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const montePisano = ee.Geometry.Point([10.5, 43.8]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Monte Pisano const startDate = '2019-02-24'; const endDate = '2019-02-27'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Active Fire Data const fireCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(montePisano); const collectionSize = fireCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fire detection images found: ${collectionSize}`); // Check for empty collection if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Count fire pixels // FireMask values: 0=not processed, 1-3=water/land/unclassified, 4-9=fire with varying confidence const fireMask = fireCollection.select('FireMask'); // Create composite and count fire pixels (confidence levels 4-9) const fireComposite = fireMask.max(); const fireCount = fireComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid fire pixels detected: ${fireCount}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (fireCount === 0) { console.log("B"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Check if any high-confidence fires exist // Count pixels with fire confidence levels (7-9 = high confidence) const highConfFire = fireComposite.gt(6); // Values 7,8,9 are high confidence fires const highConfCount = highConfFire.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: montePisano, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask').getInfo(); console.log(`High confidence fire pixels: ${highConfCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (highConfCount === null || highConfCount === undefined || isNaN(highConfCount)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (highConfCount > 0) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
